Messages.Author: Gary Schwartz
Messages.Body:
This question deals directly with Triole's Revenge, although it
applies to political actions as well. Here's the setup:

I tap a Brujah to play Triole's revenge. No one blocks or plays
Brujah Frenzy...yet. I decide to put Triole's revenge on Anson,
at which point his controller says "No way" and throws down a
Brujah Frenzy.

My question is: Does he have to play Brujah Frenzy before I've
decided which vampire get's Revenged or can he wait, as in the example,
until after I've announced?

Gary Schwartz
